summary: A model is judged on data it has not seen. You make a table of 100 support tickets, split it into train, validation and test piles, measure the accuracy of a baseline and of a one-line rule, and see how much a small pile wobbles.
goal: Split a small dataset into three piles and measure accuracy against a baseline.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: make the tickets table, run the split and see rows: 60 20 20
Step 2: change test_size to 0.2, predict the rows line, then check
Step 3: run five random seeds and see the same rule score between 0.80 and 0.95, then read the test_size error
Step 4: try seven thresholds, print train and validation accuracy, and choose with validation only
Play the Split Judge game to the end and see your score
